items.title: 2.7.1 Working with Modules in Python (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of working with modules (PDF 55-56).

blocks.text: Module Python code ki file hai, jaise functions, variables aur classes, jo program ke doosre hisson mein dobara istemal ho sakti hai. Banane ke liye code file mein likh kar .py extension se mehfooz karein.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)

blocks.text: main.py chalane se greetings import hota, us ka function bulaya jata aur 'As-Salaam-Alaikum, everyone!' print hota hai. Kitab function ka naam say_As-Salaam-Alaikum rakhti hai, jo Python ka durust naam nahi kyunke naam mein hyphen nahi ho sakta; lesson say_salaam istemal karta hai.

blocks.prompt: temperature_converter.py module banayein jis mein celsius_to_fahrenheit(c) aur fahrenheit_to_celsius(f) hon, aur main.py se 25 C aur 77 F badlein (long question 7).
blocks.explanation: temperature_converter.py mein: def celsius_to_fahrenheit(c): return 9 / 5 * c + 32 aur def fahrenheit_to_celsius(f): return 5 / 9 * (f - 32). main.py mein: import temperature_converter as tc; print(tc.celsius_to_fahrenheit(25)) se 77.0 aur print(tc.fahrenheit_to_celsius(77)) se 25.0. (Kitab 9/5 aur 5/9 ko '|' chhapti hai.)

items: Module .py file hai; import kar ke us ke functions bulayein; main() ko shuru ka nuqta rakhein.
